value.title: Project-layer code loads from the seat cwd

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR #304 r1 at 941b81a: PASS WITH NOTES (output 05793a9). OMP 18.16 loads cwd/.omp extensions first, deduped by name (builtin.ts:61-78, extension-module.ts:27, capability/index.ts:231-275), with no project-trust gate. Spawn --cwd is checked only for absolute+printable (http/mod.rs:1469); there is no same-repo check, before or after. The Pi linked-worktree refusal is CLI-only, a collision brake and not a trust boundary. Main's extension was never 'reviewed': it is main's working tree. Residual S304-N001: OMP review seats in a review-<pr> worktree execute the PR's .omp layer before the verdict, the same as Claude and Copilot project config already do. Raise it if untrusted-author PRs appear.
